diagnostics.message: No lockfile pins the dependencies of `api/go.mod`: commit the `go.sum` that its package manager writes, next to it or at the root of its workspace, and take it out of `.gitignore` if it is there
`app/package.json` names `pnpm` in `packageManager`, and its lockfile is `yarn.lock`: install with `pnpm` and delete the lockfile of the other manager, or change `packageManager`

No `.terraform.lock.hcl` pins the providers of the root module `infra/live`: run `terraform init` or `tofu init` in that folder, commit the lockfile it writes, and take it out of `.gitignore` if it is there

No lockfile pins the dependencies of `svc/pyproject.toml`: commit the `uv.lock` that its package manager writes, next to it or at the root of its workspace, and take it out of `.gitignore` if it is there

No lockfile pins the dependencies of `tool/Cargo.toml`: commit the `Cargo.lock` that its package manager writes, next to it or at the root of its workspace, and take it out of `.gitignore` if it is there
`web/package.json` has the lockfiles of 2 package managers (`pnpm-lock.yaml`, `package-lock.json`): keep the one of the manager the project uses and delete the others
